gaps: WebGPU has no point size: a PointSet with PointProperties is drawn as camera-facing squares whose size is clamp(pointSizeScaleFactor / (a + b d + c d^2), min, max) pixels (d = distance from the eye); X_ITE draws its points through its own point shader and much dimmer on this CPU raster, so size is not compared in the picture
scope: the point count is compared between the engines (ours: 4 corners of a camera-facing quad per point = 12 vertices for 3 points; X_ITE: one vertex per point); size, attenuation and the limits are field checks (and the shader formula in the gap text)
